title: Connector pairing (HTTP bodies)
description: The bodies of the two unauthenticated pairing routes the hub serves (C-05.1 to C-05.3): POST /connector/pair and POST /connector/pair/poll. Single use and non-privileged: Komodo's onboarding key (inputs/komodo-template.md) without reuse, tags, templates or the `privileged` option. The person's side (entering the code in Settings > Machines) is hub-internal and has no schema here. Nothing web-chat emits today; the nearest code is the portal start route's rules (web-chat-dev.worktrees/ae-int/lib/portal/start.js) and its throttle (lib/portal/throttle.js), whose shape the hub's pairing limits copy with a key function over the X-Forwarded-For address, counting starts rather than failures (C-05.1).

start_request.description: Body of POST https://<hub>/connector/pair (C-05.1, C-05.2). Unauthenticated and rate limited. The key pair already exists, in memory only, so the code binds this key and no other.

public_key.description: An Ed25519 public key: the raw 32 bytes, base64url without padding (contract 03 `machine.public_key.value`).

client_nonce.description: 32 random bytes, base64url, signed with the new key to prove possession.

proof.description: Signature over `web-chat-connector-pair/1\n<hub host the connector dialled>\n<client_nonce>`.

connector.description: What the person entering the code is shown beside the fingerprint, so they can tell this machine from a code someone else started. Informative; none of it is trusted.

hostname.description: os.hostname(); the name the hub proposes.

package_version.description: The connector's web-chat package version (contract 12 versions.package_version).

start_response.description: 200 answer to POST /connector/pair: the code to show and how to wait for it.

pairing_id.description: The pending pairing. Not a secret: every poll must also be signed.

code.description: The pairing code as shown: 8 Crockford base32 characters (no I, L, O, U) in two groups of four, 40 bits from a CSPRNG. Single use; dies at `expires_at`.

expires_at.description: When the code dies: 300 s after issue (C-05.2).

poll_after_ms.description: How long to wait before the first poll.

fingerprint.description: What a person compares: `SHA256:` and the unpadded standard base64 of SHA-256(raw public key), as OpenSSH prints a key and contract 06's state record stores it. Contract 03 stores the same digest as lowercase hex.

hub_id.description: The hub's stable short id, minted when the hub is installed. Contract 06 names the connector's state and key files after it.

poll_request.description: Body of POST https://<hub>/connector/pair/poll, a long poll the hub holds at most 25 s.

pairing_id.description: The pending pairing. Not a secret: every poll must also be signed.

ts.description: The connector's clock, epoch milliseconds, inside the signed string. The hub refuses a poll more than 120 s from its own clock with 400 clock_skew (a coarse replay bound, not an ordering; C-05.3).

proof.description:
Signature over `web-chat-connector-pair-poll/1
<hub host>
<pairing_id>
<ts>` by the key the start request named (C-05.3).

poll_response.description: Answer to a poll. `pending` repeats until the code is entered and confirmed, or dies.

state.description: pending: poll again. bound: the machine record exists with this key on it; write the key to disk now. expired: the code died unused. refused: the person declined it on the hub.

machine_id.description: The machine's hub id (contract 03: `mch_` and 26 lowercase Crockford base32 characters).

machine_name.description: The name the person gave the machine in Settings > Machines.

key_id.description: The key's id (contract 03 section 2, prefix `mky`): `mky_` and the first 26 characters of the Crockford base32 of SHA-256 over the raw public key, computed the same way by both sides. Names a key without carrying it.

hub_id.description: The hub's stable short id, minted when the hub is installed. Contract 06 names the connector's state and key files after it.

connect_url.description: Where to dial (C-05.4). Always the host the connector paired with.

hint.description: With expired or refused: what to do next, for the person at the machine.

error_response.description: A refused pairing request: 400, 404, 429 or 503. Never a stack, a path or whether a code exists.

error.description: Why. clock_skew: a poll's ts is more than 120 s from the hub's clock (400); the connector tells the person to set the machine's clock and does not retry until it changes.

retry_after_s.description: With rate_limited; also sent as Retry-After.
